title: Automation hits Kingston call centres
body: OBSERVER: Three Kingston BPO firms announced automated call handling this week, eliminating 400 entry-level positions. Platforms offering delivery and domestic services report signup surges. The Jamaica Gleaner called it 'the gig economy acceleration.' The floor just moved.

title: Papine Traders' Collective opens new block
body: GLEANER: The Papine Traders' Collective opened a covered market on Mona Road Saturday. 48 stalls, all informal economy operators. Stalls go for $30 a week. The chairman says they want people who are building something, not just selling.

choices.label: Rent a stall and test your product there.
Note it and wait for the next round.

title: Caribbean property up 18% in 18 months
body: GLEANER/REUTERS: Regional consultancy Caribbuild reports Kingston median residential prices rose 18% in 18 months on diaspora demand and limited supply. Analysts say the window for first-time buyers under $50K is closing fast.

choices.label: Start saving hard for a property deposit.
Invest in a business instead — higher returns.

title: JPS solar rollout opens 200 installation jobs
body: GLEANER: Jamaica Public Service announced a $40M solar micro-grid programme across 12 parishes. Installation contractors are advertising immediately. No formal certification required for entry labour. Supervisors earn $18 an hour on the government rate card.
